verdict.rationale: HeyGen documents turbo and quality enhancement modes for its `heygen-video-1` prompt-to-video model, which gives a fast draft path and a higher-quality path. Its Video Agent also lets creators review storyboards and iterate before generating a full video. Nothing shows the turbo mode is cheaper, though, and nothing shows a drafted take can be upscaled; a creator would apparently re-generate at quality rather than promote the chosen take. missing for 10: documented cost difference between draft and final modes, an explicit upscale or re-render-chosen-take workflow, evidence that 4K export applies to an upscaled draft, hands-on or independent corroboration.
